name: Yucatan Geotube submerged breakwater
type: geotextile tube submerged/low-crested breakwater (+ dune reinforcement)
year_built: seed citation (Gonzalez Leija et al. 2014) is a lab wave-flume study, not a field build year [R1]; related field project near Progreso built from Sept 2005 [R2][R3]; a separate, later Progreso installation began Oct 2025 [R5][R8][R9]
status: contested/mixed - 2012 designer report claims associated Progreso 7km nourishment 'stable for about 10 years, even without maintenance' [R4]; 2025 press describes region-wide results as 'dispares' (mixed) and a second Progreso install was underway Oct 2025 [R5][R6]

dimensions.lab_model_2014: 1:5 and 1:10 scale in a 37 x 0.8 x 1.2 m flume [R1]
dimensions.field_2005: 4 km total tube length, ~15-30 m offshore, tube height 0.9 m, width 1.85 m, cross-section 1.4 m2 at 70% fill, 2.0 m segments, ~15 m inlet spacing [R2][R3]
dimensions.field_2025: 7 discrete tubes, each 6-10 m long, 1-1.5 m diameter [R5][R9]

cost: not found for either the 2005 or 2025 field projects (unreferenced - needs source)
designer: 2005: Axis Ingenieria S.A. de C.V. / Ing. Enrique Alvarez del Rio [R2][R4]; 2025: Constructora Pech / Raul Roberto Pech Figueroa [R8][R9]
contractor: 2005: geotextile supplier TenCate Nicolon [R2]; 2025: Constructora Pech [R8]
financed_by: 2005: Ministry of the Environment of Mexico, Yucatan office, under a 2001 federal Beach Rehabilitation Program [R2]; 2025: Progreso municipal government [R5][R8]
motivation: chronic ~1 m/yr shoreline erosion along northern Yucatan, driven partly by the Progreso pier blocking longshore sediment transport and by unauthorized private groins [R2][R4]
outcome: short/medium-term sediment accretion of 0.45-0.90 m measured after 2005 install (70% within first 6 months) [R3]; designers' own 2012 claim of ~10-year stability for the associated nourishment [R4]; but 2025 journalism reports mixed/disputed regional results and a second Progreso install underway, with tube fabric sometimes deteriorating within 6-12 months [R5][R6][R9]
relation_to_master_list: seeded from 02_research/00_master_list.md row yucatan-geotube-mexico, citing Gonzalez Leija, M. et al. 2014, Coastal Eng. Proc. 1:25; master list flagged the source as possibly lab/physical-model scale rather than a field installation - confirmed true: the 2014 paper is a UNAM wave-flume experiment [R1]
